source.text: Next spring's Paper Birds studio revival is separately commissioned. New director, new fixed set, its own rehearsal budget; it is not another autumn tour stop.
Paper Birds autumn tour: one production visits Moss Hall and Reed Theatre with the same cast and folding set. Venue adjustments stay within this tour.
Youth centre booked a standalone shadow-theatre workshop. Build small practice screens and finish with each group presenting a scene.
Material handover: offcuts from the separately built Paper Birds studio-revival set will make the youth workshop's practice screens. Record the donation against both projects.
Reed Theatre stop of the autumn tour: fold the left panel inward for the narrow wing. Keep the Moss Hall arrangement in the same touring cue book.
Make the screen taller; they cannot see the bird.
The taller-screen memo is for the youth shadow workshop's practice screens. The children need to see the bird over the table edge.
Youth shadow workshop recording: the taller practice screens made from revival offcuts let each group perform its bird scene without lifting the tables.

events.reason: c09 identifies the screen-height memo as a youth workshop instruction. Assign it to that standalone workshop.

source.text: Bicycle repair photo: rear rim is buckled beside two broken spokes. Record spoke length before rebuilding and tensioning the wheel.
Transport estimate compares the Paper Birds autumn folding set with next spring's studio-revival set. Same haulier, separate collection dates and job numbers.

events.text: Reed Theatre stop of the autumn tour: fold the left panel inward by 30 degrees for the narrow wing. Keep the Moss Hall arrangement in the same touring cue book.

source.text: Reed Theatre autumn-tour rehearsal clip: the revised left-panel fold clears the wing, and the touring bird silhouette remains visible from the back row.
Autumn tour closed after Reed Theatre. The inward panel fold worked; preserve both venue configurations in the Paper Birds touring report.
